name: @pipeworx/mcp-gtin

tools.name: validate_gtin
tools.description: Validate a barcode number — EAN-13, UPC-A (12), EAN-8, or GTIN-14 (keyless, offline). Checks the mod-10 check digit, reports the format, normalizes to GTIN-14, and returns the GS1 prefix + issuing country/region. Spaces/dashes ignored. Validates the number, not the product.

tools.name: gtin_check_digit
tools.description: Compute the mod-10 check digit for GTIN/EAN/UPC data digits (all digits EXCEPT the check digit). Use to generate or repair a barcode.

data.description: The data digits without the check digit, e.g. "400638133393".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-gtin forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the gtin pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
